This rich multiple is completely unsupported by operational reality, given that the return on capital employed sits at a stagnant 0% compared to a sector benchmark of 6.31% [E8]. Compounding the operational weakness, the trailing twelve months profit growth has collapsed by -174% [E15], and long-term 10-year compounded profit growth is negative at -2% [E12]. Furthermore, the company destroys shareholder capital through core operations, evidenced by a dismal Return on Assets of -5.67% versus the sector benchmark of 1.55% [E6], while offering a zero dividend yield [E2]. Expectations are dangerously detached from delivery, with recent price growth outpacing profit growth by 131% [E44] while the stock languishes at the bottom 12% of its 52-week range [E3]. However, the bull's reliance on earnings growth accelerating [E52] is entirely undermined by the catastrophic trailing twelve months profit growth collapse of -174% [E15]. Conceded: the ROE prints an astronomical 7845.1% [E7], but this figure is a mathematical distortion rendered meaningless by an immobilized ROCE of 0% [E8] and a negative ROA of -5.67% [E6]. The bull claims the tiny ₹ 5.00 Cr market capitalization [E1] and depressed trading level at 12% of the 52-week range [E3] create an asymmetric opportunity, yet this low valuation correctly reflects a severely distressed balance sheet carrying an egregious P/B of 11.58x against a 1.54x sector benchmark [E5].
